test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What was the slogan of the 2024 United Nations Biodiversity Convention (COP16) initially held in 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Peace with Nature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The slogan **“Peace with Nature”** emphasizes the critical need to establish harmony between human activities and the natural environment.
 
• The United Nations Biodiversity Convention (**COP16**) in 2024 aimed to address the growing concerns related to **biodiversity loss** and the degradation of ecosystems.
 
• It reflects the United Nations' commitment to ensuring a sustainable future by fostering cooperation for the protection and restoration of natural habitats.
 
• The slogan aligns with the overarching goals of the **Post-2020 Global Biodiversity Framework**, which seeks transformative changes to halt biodiversity loss.
 
• It underscores the importance of integrating **environmental conservation** into global peace-building efforts, highlighting how ecological balance contributes to societal stability.
 
• The convention also serves as a platform for countries to pledge actions and policies that promote **sustainable development** while addressing climate change and conserving biodiversity.
 
• The slogan resonates deeply with the need for global collaboration to safeguard the planet's natural resources for future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **From Biodiversity to Nature**__

 __
 
• This phrase lacks the broader focus on peace and sustainability, which is central to the slogan “Peace with Nature.”
 
• It may imply a narrower scope, focusing only on biodiversity without addressing human-nature coexistence.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Peace**__
 __
 
• While this term highlights peace in an environmental context, it does not fully encapsulate the idea of achieving harmony with nature as a whole.
 
• It focuses more on the abstract concept of peace rather than actionable coexistence with natural ecosystems.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity to Peace**__
 
 
• This option suggests a transition or relationship between biodiversity and peace but lacks the holistic approach of “Peace with Nature.”
 
• It does not strongly emphasize the integration of human activities with ecological balance.
